general_information.summary: Nestled on an island renowned for its “year-round sunshine”, Vinpearl Golf Nha Trang showcases a unique terrain, surrounded by verdant hills, offering a panoramic view of the heavenly bay. Designed by IMG Worldwide, the golf course preserves the natural beauty with characteristic features of expansive fairways, meandering and undulating along the hillsides. It promises to be an ideal destination for challenging and inspiring swings.
general_information.terrain_and_landscape: Surrounded by verdant hills; Panoramic view of the bay; Fairways meandering and undulating along the hillsides
